title: Semantic-type extraction catalog
description: Extraction matcher catalog (registry/semantic-types.yaml) — NOT the semantic-type authority. Each entry is keyed by its bare `id`, which capability input matchers reference via {"kind": "semanticType", "ref": "<entryId>"}; those ids are matcher names, not semantic types. The authority is the `sapnexus:*` ontology vocabulary declared by capability inputs/outputs, reached from here through the one-way `extracts` key. Duplicate entry ids are allowed by this schema and rejected by the registry validator.

version.description: Catalog revision; bumped on every structural change.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by capability matchers.

extracts.description: One-way mapping to the semantic-type authority: the single `sapnexus:*` ontology type this matcher extracts from user text. Several matchers may extract the same ontology type; a single matcher may never extract two, which is why this is a string and not an array. Not every ontology type has a matcher — derived-only types have none.

priority.description: Resolution priority when multiple entries match.

prefix.description: Literal tokens anchoring the value BEFORE them; alternated when multiple.

suffix.description: Literal tokens anchoring the value AFTER them; alternated when multiple.

valueShape.description: Name of a catalog-level valueShapes entry supplying the capture shape.

justification.description: Required for kind regex: why the named kinds cannot express this matcher (escape hatch).

valueShapes.description: Named value shapes referenced by prefixed/suffixed/valueShape matchers via the matcher's valueShape key (e.g. plantCode: '^[A-Z0-9]{4}$').
